messages.subject: ESG & Responsible Business Executive | External Affairs & Stakeholder Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Peacocke,

Impact Beyond's work around sustainability, impact and responsible-business leadership makes this a relevant introduction for senior mandates.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans ESG and social performance, government and regulatory relations, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications in a major natural-resources environment.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership roles where responsible growth depends on institutional trust, stakeholder confidence, regulatory discipline and measurable ESG execution. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC, while I remain internationally mobile for global appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for relevant current or future mandates across ESG, sustainability, responsible business, external affairs and stakeholder leadership.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
